description:
Export survey response data and structure for the 'Q3 2024 Retail Customer Experience Survey'. 

1. Log in to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!).
2. Navigate to the 'Q3 2024 Retail Customer Experience Survey' which has 25 collected responses.
3. Export all 25 responses as a CSV file. Ensure the export includes the full dataset. Save the file to '/home/ga/Downloads/q3_customer_experience_responses.csv'.
4. Export the survey structure (LSS format) to archive the questions. Save the file to '/home/ga/Downloads/q3_customer_experience_structure.lss'.
